name: printgoat-pp-mcp
description: Search and reliably download 3D-print files across Printables and Thingiverse (plus search Cults3D) — with real resumable downloads and cross-site duplicate detection nothing else has.

cults3d_api_key.title: CULTS3D_API_KEY
cults3d_api_key.description: Optional. Sets CULTS3D_API_KEY for the PrintGoat MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

cults3d_username.title: CULTS3D_USERNAME
cults3d_username.description: Optional. Sets CULTS3D_USERNAME for the PrintGoat MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.
